payout_quote: Get a $250 bonus when you open any new business checking account. Plus, receive a $100 credit toward your first business check order. After the fourth deposit/withdrawal has been credited/debited from the Business Checking Account, Washington Trust will make a $250.00 deposit into an interest-bearing Business or Consumer Account of your choice within thirty (30) calendar days.
steps: Mention the offer at the time of account opening.
Open a new Washington Trust business checking account with at least $50 from sources other than Washington Trust.
Complete four (4) deposits or withdrawals with sources labeled as ACH, credited/debited to the new account, within ninety (90) calendar days of account opening.
Washington Trust deposits $250 into an interest-bearing business or consumer account of your choice within 30 calendar days after the fourth qualifying ACH deposit/withdrawal.
Separately receive a $100 credit toward your first business check order (no cash value).
catches: No fixed end date — the offer 'may be withdrawn at any time'.
Must mention the offer at account opening; opening funds must come from sources other than Washington Trust.
Only ACH-labeled deposits or withdrawals count toward the four required transactions.
The $100 check-order credit has no cash value — it is a discount, not money in your pocket.
'Additional terms and conditions apply' — full business account terms and monthly fee schedule are in the bank's Common Fee Schedule, not on the promo page; fee drag could reduce net value.
Bonus subject to IRS 1099 reporting — taxable interest income.
Washington Trust is a Rhode Island community bank — branches statewide; account opening is branch/in-person.
biggest_catch: This is one of the easiest business bonuses to earn (just four ACH transactions in 90 days, $50 to open), but the promo page lists no fixed expiry — the bank can withdraw it at any time — and the $100 'credit' toward check orders is a no-cash-value discount, not part of the cash payout. Confirm the offer is still active when you open the account.
eligibility: Open a new Washington Trust business checking account ($50 minimum, funds from outside Washington Trust), mention the offer at opening, and complete 4 ACH-labeled deposits/withdrawals within 90 calendar days.
timing: Offer may be withdrawn at any time (no fixed expiry); qualifying ACH activity must post within 90 calendar days of account opening; $250 paid within 30 calendar days after the fourth qualifying transaction.
